environment.description: Same Spring Boot application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate. The ALB has a listener on port 443 with TLS termination. The ALB's security group (sg-0a3f8e92c1d4b7f56) has inbound rules restricted to three CIDR blocks: 10.200.0.0/16 (internal VPC peering from cluster nodes), 172.20.0.0/14 (corporate VPN egress range), and 192.168.100.0/24 (management bastion subnet). These correspond to the known peer node ranges and operations team access. The security group has no other inbound rules. Additionally, the VPC's route table for the ALB subnets has no internet gateway route — the ALB is an internal ALB (scheme: internal) with DNS resolution only available within the connected VPCs. The ECS task role has no public IP assignment. Note: the application still uses native Java deserialization without JEP-290 filters, and commons-collections4-4.0.jar remains on the classpath. The /debug/serial-filter endpoint confirms no ObjectInputFilter is active.

config.vpc_route_table: no internet gateway, only VPC peering and TGW routes
config.dns_resolution: internal Route53 private hosted zone only
